justification: The only real correspondence is generic: both surfaces are upright fields organised into horizontal registers with profile figures and a row of repeated small motifs across an upper band. What is actually depicted differs entirely atched of that scaffolding: A shows bold, schematic animals (bird-like creatures, a snake, quadrupeds) stacked in isolation, while B shows a scene of human figures flanking an offering table beneath a disc, above a large panel of dense sign-rows.
